title: TabPac
description: A cool alternative to the Tab plugin. Smaller than Tab and has almost all the Tab plugin features.
body:
# TabPac 🏷️

![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange?style=for-the-badge&logo=openjdk)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Paper-aqua?style=for-the-badge)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green?style=for-the-badge)

**TabPac** is a modern, lightweight, and highly customizable solution for your server's Tablist and Sidebar Scoreboard. Designed for Paper/Spigot 1.21.x, it offers a "branded" experience with smooth animations and smart features.

---

## ✨ Key Features

*   **🎨 Dynamic Tablist**: Fully customizable header and footer with multi-line support.
*   **📊 Sidebar Scoreboard**: Sleek sidebar to display player stats, server info, and more.
*   **🎬 Animation Engine**: Create smooth, frame-based animations for any text in the Tab or Scoreboard.
*   **⚖️ Smart Sorting**: Organize players in the Tablist based on a custom priority list (e.g., Admin > Moderator > Player).
*   **💤 AFK Support**: Built-in integration with EssentialsX to show AFK status.
*   **🌍 Multi-Language**: Native support for **English**, **Russian**, **Ukrainian**, and **Belarusian**.
*   **🛠️ Admin Notifications**: Smart system that reminds you to set your language and notifies about missing PAPI expansions.

---

## 🚀 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/tabpac` | Main command, shows version info | `tabpac.use` |
| `/tabpac reload` | Reloads configuration and languages | `tabpac.reload` |
| `/tabpac papi download` | Auto-installs required PAPI expansions | `tabpac.admin` |

---

## 📦 Installation (v1.0.0-rec.2)

1.  Download the latest **TabPac-1.0.0-rec.2.jar**.
2.  Place it in your server's `plugins` folder.
3.  Install [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) and [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/).
4.  Restart the server.
5.  Run `/tabpac papi download` to set up required placeholders automatically.
6.  **⚠️ Important:** By default, the plugin uses the `start` language. If you don't change it in `config.yml`, OPs will receive a reminder every 30 seconds!
